{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0491","text":"Forwarding this again since I gather the first one landed in a few spam folders. Or got declined without a reason, which I'm sure was also a spam folder thing. Attendance is expected, cameras on would be lovely. Vera

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Vera
To: All Staff - Kowalczyk Partners (118)
Subject: Q3 Town Hall - Thursday 9:00-9:30

All,

Quarterly town hall, 30 minutes. I've kept the agenda tight, so please hold questions for the slot at the end rather than the chat. Last time the chat turned into a parallel meeting, and nobody enjoyed that.

9:00 - Q3 utilisation and pipeline numbers (Fern Iversen). These are also in the dashboard everyone has had access to since Monday, so this is a recap for anyone who hasn't clicked the link yet.
9:07 - Project Foxglove client wrap-up and lessons learned (Fatima Jaramillo)
9:12 - New timesheet submission deadline, effective next month (Esme Achterberg). This is the third reminder. It will be the last one delivered with a smile.
9:15 - Partner promotion round: timeline and how nominations will work (Soren Quintero)
9:20 - Office move: floor plan options. We need a show of hands on the two layouts, since the landlord wants an answer by Friday (Jonas Vasquez)
9:25 - Open Q&A (Andre Bramwell moderating)

Slides go out afterwards for anyone who "has a clash."

Thanks,
Vera"},{"spec_id":"spec_0492","text":"Subject: MANDATORY: Project Indigo Revised Shooting Schedule - Department Head Review

To: Wes Moreau; Rosa Delacroix; Nadia Rasmussen; Oskar Xu; Jamal Whitcombe; Xavier Hollander

Good afternoon,

Now that Elmcrest Pictures has formally greenlit Project Foxglove, I am requesting a meeting of the core team at your earliest convenience. Please hold 60 minutes in the Development Suite on Wednesday, 10:00-11:00.

In keeping with Elmcrest Pictures' development procedures, attendance in person is preferred, and delegates should not be sent in place of named attendees. Kindly bring any materials you consider relevant to your area.

Please confirm receipt and availability with my office by end of day Monday so the room booking can be finalised.

Regards,
Sofia
Head of Development
